author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜನರಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವರು ಎದ್ದರೂ ಬಿದ್ದರೂ
ಮನವ ಕಸಿಯಲು ಬಿಡದೆ ಕಾಪಾಡು ಅದನು
ದಿನಪನಂತಿರೆ ವದನ ಭಾವವನು ತೋರದಿರೆ
ಜನಜನಿತ ನಿನ್ನನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: People will talk whether you rise or fall;
do not let them rob your mind, keep it safe;
if your face is steady as the sun and shows no stir,
your conduct will be known to all, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Gossip follows success and failure alike. Guard your mind from it. Stay as even as the sun, and your character will speak for itself.
